changes.procedural_scope: Exclude judicial-only relief such as letters to authorities, judicial deposit authorization, legal aid, costs, fees and bad-faith sanctions from the bilateral mediation catalog.
changes.party_relief: Preserve release, restitution or payment of deposited funds in favor of a party.
changes.civil_penalties: Preserve expressly requested civil or contractual penalties as autonomous monetary claims.
changes.reviewer_normalization: Ignore reviewer omission objections that concern only judicial procedural relief while retaining substantive omissions.
changes.compact_panels: Require one short sentence and at most 160 characters per common textual decision field to reduce truncation risk in complex cases.
